items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: I couldn't call up Lu to come get me. She didn't know where to find -- you know, we were strangers. We didn't know anybody.

ctx.x: When it would rain or the sun got too bright on the highway, I'd have to stop. If the road had white dust on it, the reflection was too great, I couldn't see. It was just a vast cloud in front of me. And, as I say, when I got here, I couldn't find my way back. I got the kids to school, but -- he helped me to see the streets, but when I put him in school and came home, I got lost, and we didn't have the phone in yet and I couldn't call up Lu to come get me. She didn't know where to find -- you know, we were…

Education?" All that -- the real estate agent helped me. So I knew then I had to have the operation and I had it on September 28. We arrived here September the 6th or 7th and I had this operation and that's it. And I couldn't even blow an instrument for six months because any pressure would have burst the small capillaries or something in my eyes. The operation would have been bad.
